brief: AI spending spikes and tech stock jitters dominate financial news, while Trump eulogizes Lindsey Graham and Iran tensions threaten oil routes. Research focuses on explainable AI in code review and visualization techniques for complex data.
news_summary: AI leaders urge government action on automation, and Google's increased spending estimate to $205B fuels Wall Street nervousness. Meanwhile, Trump praises Lindsey Graham at his funeral, and Iran war risks intensify around the Strait of Hormuz.
papers_summary: A study evaluates how explainable AI affects trust in AI-assisted code review, while other papers explore contour ensemble visualization and Arabic context design tools.

zh.brief: 唐山大地震50周年之际，相关历史细节与影响被重温，同时香港前议员胡志伟赴英后遭扣留事件持续发酵。国际方面，美伊局势、AI支出争议及科技股波动受关注。
zh.news_summary: 唐山大地震50周年，多个报道回顾历史细节与长期影响；胡志伟赴英后被扣留近10小时，否认寻求庇护。美国与伊朗紧张关系持续，AI支出增加引发市场担忧。
zh.papers_summary: 今日无优先论文，英文论文重点涉及可解释AI在代码审查中的信任影响、二维标量场轮廓集合可视化、阿拉伯语境下的设计实践以及量子电路可视化设计空间等。

todays_image.caption: Just as the sprawling, unregulated growth of Lobophora algae can overtake coral reefs, unchecked automated AI could overwhelm society without government intervention.
